featured_reviews.name: Pranjal Shah
featured_reviews.review_text:
Samriddhi Banquet delivered a wonderful experience from start to finish. Everything was seamless, from the initial booking and food tasting to accommodating last-minute changes, the entire process was extremely well-managed and completely stress-free for us. A special mention to Rohit for his excellent coordination and support. He ensured every detail was handled with care and professionalism.

The food was outstanding, with great taste and quality that all our guests truly enjoyed. The Jain food options were equally delicious and thoughtfully prepared, which we really appreciated. The elegant décor and beautiful ambience added a lovely touch to the event.

Highly recommended for anyone looking for a well-organized venue with great hospitality and amazing food.

featured_reviews.name: Aditya Sawant
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently had the pleasure of hosting an event at the Gopuram Hall, and I must say, it exceeded all expectations. The banquet hall itself was simply stunning. With its elegant and modern decor, it provided the perfect backdrop for our special occasion. The spacious layout allowed for a comfortable guest experience, and the attention to detail in the decoration was remarkable.

When it comes to the food quality, Gopuram truly shone. The culinary experience was exceptional. The menu offered a wide variety of options to suit all tastes, and the dishes were prepared to perfection. The flavors were exquisite, and the presentation was a work of art. It was evident that the chefs took great pride in their craft, and it certainly showed in every bite.

As for the ambience, it was nothing short of magical. The lighting and decor created a warm and inviting atmosphere that set the perfect mood for our event. The banquet hall's team paid close attention to lighting, music, and overall aesthetics, ensuring a memorable and immersive experience for all our guests.

The staff at Gopuram Hall was also top-notch. They were attentive, friendly, and always ready to assist with any request. Their professionalism and dedication added a personal touch that made the event run seamlessly.

In conclusion, Gopuram Hall is a gem among event venues. The place is exquisite, the food quality is outstanding, and the ambience is truly enchanting. It's the perfect choice for any special occasion, and I wholeheartedly recommend it to anyone seeking a memorable and elegant event experience.

featured_reviews.name: Amogh T.
featured_reviews.review_text:
This is an excellent Banquet Hall located in the heart of Khar West in a bylane.

There are 2 main areas - the primary hall on 1st floor for functions and the dining area on ground floor which can easily fit around a dozen large tables.

The entry and internal decoration is well done and lavish.

Food menu has large variety across multiple budget ranges.

Street parking is less but they provide valet parking service.

featured_reviews.name: Vyom
featured_reviews.review_text:
GA Kulkarni Banquet is a well-designed, spacious venue ideal for gatherings and rotating public. The hall offers ample space, comfortably accommodating around 200 guests in a compact yet efficient layout. The main stage stands out with its impressive décor and excellent lighting, making it perfect for events and ceremonies.

Outside, there is sufficient road space for easy movement and parking convenience.
The highlight of the banquet, however, was the food every item was top-notch, and guests genuinely appreciated the taste and quality.

A great venue overall for functions and celebrations.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Thank you for the wonderful review. We are delighted that you enjoyed the venue, décor, spacious layout, and food. Looking forward to hosting your future celebrations.

featured_reviews.name: Rushikesh patwardhan
featured_reviews.review_text: Awsome luxurious hall with good amenities and very well managed staff with all traditional female staff with navari saadi with huge weeding hall and decoration was amazing enjoyed today's wedding event extremely happy

featured_reviews.name: Mokshada Mihir Hardas
featured_reviews.review_text:
The event of my son's "Upanayan" was one of it's kind!
The entire team put up an unforgettable experience for each and every person present. The ambiance, the decor, the arrangements, the staff and especially the food was something that will remain with us forever. Every instruction and finer details were taken care of. I would specially like to mention the wonderful setup of "Acharya Kutiya" which was brought to life with jute fabric, fresh flowers and coconut leaves; graceful yet subtle, elegant yet simple! The food was typically prepared to suit maharashtrian brahmin sensibilities and was served on fresh banana leaves taking the culinary experience a notch up.
Mr. Shashank Kadam is a man of fine taste and understanding and it reflects in his work. His passion for what he does makes a simple event an experience to remember for a lifetime. You rock team Ameeta !!!

Hall is very near to Mulund West railway station... You will not get any parking... Good for small functions only...

featured_reviews.name: Rinkesh Shah
featured_reviews.review_text:
This place is located very close to mulund railway station West. It is a small hall which can be used to  organise various functions. It also has air condition available. From small get-together to marriage function, all can be carried out here. Majority of the times, there is some or the other exhibition organised here.
The location is prime but the major flaw is parking place. Being in the market area there is no parking available. The road outside the hall is overly crowded. There is also lot of mess around the hall as vegetable and fruit market is present.
Nevertheless decent place to organise small functions.

featured_reviews.name: Man V
featured_reviews.review_text: Good Place for small events and function. Parking is really headache. Forget about 4 wheel even 2 wheel parking is Major hurdle in busy street.

featured_reviews.name: Manoj Shah
featured_reviews.review_text: Very good place for all type of functions. Different types and sizes of banquet available. Only and big problem is location. It is right in main market of Mulund, so very difficult for cars and scooter.

featured_reviews.name: Nikhil Parab
featured_reviews.review_text:
Review for the Hall:

This hall leaves much to be desired in terms of comfort and accessibility:

1. Accessibility: There is no lift facility, which is highly inconvenient, especially since the changing room is on the first floor and the hall itself is on the second floor.

2. Air Conditioning: The AC was inadequate, failing to cool the space effectively.

3. Ambience: The overall ambience was poor, lacking a welcoming or elegant feel.

Overall: The hall is not well-suited for events requiring comfort or accessibility. Improvements in infrastructure and ambiance are essential.

featured_reviews.name: Rajdeep Singh
featured_reviews.review_text:
Vijay Society Hall is located at a distance of 500 metres from Mulund station (W).
Hall is good for marriage purposes and can accommodate 150 - 250 guests.
Washroom is on the first floor for ladies and Gents.
Reception area is on the 3rd floor and dining area in just above it.
There are no lifts so staircase is the only option to go to the above floors.
There is no monopoly for caterers and decorators so you can plan as per your requirement.

Overall 3.5 rating would be justified for this place.

featured_reviews.name: Adrian Rodrigues
featured_reviews.review_text: It's a good venue at a good location. There is no parking available there but you can park on the smaller lanes around the hall. The upper AC hall is well lit and has a big stage capacity of that hall for theatre style seating is about 200 people. Food is ok the Panipuri there is recommended which is really good and must be on your menu. The washroom downstairs are not so great and there aren't enough washrooms if the crowd is large. They have non AC halls as well to accommodate your budget.

featured_reviews.name: Rahul Kandari
featured_reviews.review_text:
Decent place for 150-200 people in the air-conditioned floor.

The passage area is narrow which is an inconvenience when a lot people move in/out together.

featured_reviews.name: Deepak Kumar
featured_reviews.review_text: Nice hall with G + 2 floor. Washrooms are neat and clean. Staff is helpful and decent. BMC garden next to tha hall.

featured_reviews.name: Manoj Shah
featured_reviews.review_text: Good banquet hall with reasonable rates. Best thing for Jain's is, onion and garlic are not allowed to use here. So it's easy for Jain to manage food options. Nice hall with good decor.👍

featured_reviews.name: sudalai muthu
featured_reviews.review_text: The place is easily accessible by auto rickshaw.. there are more staffs who keep the hall clean after every function... Price is reasonable compared to other hall in the area

featured_reviews.name: vijayshanker dave
featured_reviews.review_text:
Washrooms are way behind any cleanliness.
The ground floor hall is stuffy and needs proper ventilation.
Bottled water only should be served

Forum decorators also known as Hiravati Banquet Hall, is a wedding hall, ideally located in Santa Cruz (west) Mumbai. It has the capacity to accommodate 400 +  people for a reception function. featured_reviews.review_text: Excellent AC Hall for Functions,Ample Height inside the hall for Easy Air Serculation and a Specious place for Lunch/Dinner which is Indoor as well Outside Open Space, The Food & Services from Rajesh Caterers was Excellent,Really a Good Experience, Thankyou🙏

featured_reviews.name: Rohan Mehta
featured_reviews.review_text: Hiravati Banquet is a spacious and well-designed venue, perfect for large gatherings. The interior is elegant and adds a classy touch to any event. The only drawback was the food—I'm not sure if it was their in-house catering or an external service, but it could have been better. Overall, a great place for hosting grand celebrations.

featured_reviews.name: Mayur Deshmukh
featured_reviews.review_text:
Hiravati Banquet Hall, Santacruz is an excellent venue for hosting mid-sized events like weddings, engagements, or receptions. The place is surprisingly quiet and peaceful, making it perfect for intimate yet elegant gatherings.

It has a separate dining hall, which helps manage the event flow smoothly, and the entrance lobby offers a comfortable sitting area — ideal for arranging small interactive activities like a caricature artist or photo booth.

The AC and lighting setup are top-notch, adding a touch of luxury to any celebration. Overall, a well-maintained and thoughtfully designed banquet hall that makes every event feel special.

Highly recommended!

featured_reviews.name: Ramnik Sheth
featured_reviews.review_text: About - Hiravati banquet hall is well maintained, decoration is good, but but very costly, situated in Santacruz at Tagore Road is a very narrow road location for traffic, monopoly in catering service & also costly, behavior of catering manager is rough as per last week experience.

featured_reviews.name: Bernardine Alphonso Fernandes
featured_reviews.review_text:
We recently hosted our Roce ceremony here, and it turned out to be a truly memorable and joyful celebration. The banquet hall was beautifully decorated according to our theme, exactly as I had requested, and it provided the perfect setting for our special day.

The staff were professional, friendly, and very supportive in ensuring everything was well organized. Their attention to detail and hospitality really stood out throughout the event. I had shared a small suggestion regarding the portion size of the starter menu, which they kindly acknowledged and assured us they would consider for the future.

The main course was excellent—served fresh and hot, which is something guests always appreciate.

Overall, everything was handled very well. Ola, Thank you for helping make our celebration so special. This is really a great place for anyone looking to host family events.
Highly recommended!

featured_reviews.name: Shraddha Mestry
featured_reviews.review_text:
We celebrated our parents 30th anniversary at Ola Vakkola and honestly, they made the whole evening a seamless experience.

From the first call to the final goodbye, their responses were prompt. Every request was handled quickly, no chasing or follow-ups needed.

The team is genuinely warm and helpful. They listened to what we wanted and went out of their way to make sure everything ran smooth.

Decor was elegant, exactly as planned. Music setup was on point, and the food was fresh, delicious, and loved by all our guests.

The event was a total hit because of their prompt service and cooperative attitude. If you want a stress-free celebration with great food, music, and vibe, Ola Vakkola is the place.

Highly recommended! ✨

featured_reviews.name: Komal Torne
featured_reviews.review_text:
We recently celebrated my mother's 61st Birthday At this beautiful banquet, I gave given 1 less star for little low AC, no parking facility, very high charges for delay in closer, no lift or special staircase for wheelchair, low light on stage

4 stars for other facilities like mesmerizing decoration, amazing energetic game host sagar who kept the guest engaged and active with his games, our guest enjoyed all games very much, very cooperative and humble event manager deepak who was available on site for full time assistance, good sound facility, cleanliness of washrooms , hall and sparrow room. All guest loved the hall ambience very much.
Thank you for making our special day most memorable. 💗

featured_reviews.name: Samiksha Nade
featured_reviews.review_text:
We recently celebrated our daughter’s naming ceremony at Ola Banquet, Vakola, and the entire experience was truly memorable. The hall was beautifully maintained—clean, spacious, and perfect for a family gathering. The decor was elegant and added a lovely charm to our special day.

The staff was very professional and cooperative throughout the planning and the event. They ensured everything was in place and executed smoothly. The food was another highlight—delicious, well-prepared, and thoroughly enjoyed by all our guests.

We are really happy we chose Ola Banquet for this important day. Highly recommended for anyone looking for a great venue in Santacruz/Vakola!

featured_reviews.name: Ashvita Shetty
featured_reviews.review_text:
We recently hosted a small event at this banquet hall, and the experience exceeded our expectations. The team was extremely attentive and always on their toes, making sure all our requirements were met promptly and efficiently.

The food was delicious and well-received by all our guests, and the service throughout the event was smooth and professional. Everything was handled with care, which made the occasion stress-free for us.

Overall, we’re very happy with how everything turned out and would definitely recommend this venue to others looking for a reliable and well-managed space.

featured_reviews.name: Girish Surgical Works
featured_reviews.review_text: I recently had the pleasure of celebrating a Kelvan for our teammate, Shweta Madam, and it exceeded all expectations! The Ola Vakola Banquet Hall was clean and comfortable, the amenities were top-notch, and the location was perfect. The food (both veg and non-veg) was excellent and truly up to the mark. A special thanks to the sandesh sir even his team was friendly and helpful staff for making it a great experience

featured_reviews.name: Pravesh Shrivas
featured_reviews.review_text: We recently celebrated our child’s first birthday, and it was an absolutely wonderful experience! The event was beautifully organized, with every detail taken care of perfectly. The decorations were stunning and created a festive and joyful atmosphere. The food was delicious and enjoyed by all our guests. The DJ and sound setup were fantastic, adding so much energy and fun to the celebration—everyone had a great time dancing! Everything ran smoothly, making the day truly special for us and our little one. A big thank you to everyone involved in making this celebration so memorable! Highly recommended!

featured_reviews.name: Priti Shejwal
featured_reviews.review_text: Here at Ola Vakola Banquet, My engagement event went well.  Everything was good—food, décor, and all the staff members were cooperative. The only thing I didn’t like was that full payment had to be made before the event. Apart from that, the overall experience was good.

featured_reviews.review_text: Nice for any kind of family function, get together or engagement and all, I personally visited the place, it is near khar road railway station within 5 mins walking distance. The caterers are good.

featured_reviews.name: Gautam Nayak
featured_reviews.review_text: Good air-conditioned hall for small functions of up to 150 or 200 persons. Lack of parking facility is a major problem, as it is difficult to get parking nearby. Good quality catering as well. Dining area on ground floor is not air-conditioned.

featured_reviews.name: aamit parab
featured_reviews.review_text: Very good hall . Parking is big problem outside hall

featured_reviews.name: Uday Mankikar
featured_reviews.review_text: Nice place located in a residential area. Well maintained. Hall is on the first floor and dining arrangements are on the ground floor. Lift is available for going to the hall. Staff is nice. Valet parking is available. It is situated on 12th road, Khar west.

featured_reviews.name: ajaz shaikh
featured_reviews.review_text: Good for small parties. The lift is very dangerous. It's just grill closer and during events kids constantly try to put hands in grills. I myself pulled 2 kids putting hand in grill and the lift was about to come down. I was very horrified with this that instead of concentrating on the event my whole attention was on that lift

featured_reviews.name: rasik vijayakar
featured_reviews.review_text: ground +2 upper floors for wedding cerimony or any other such functions.All the halls capacity 200 persons each.Ground floor hall is used for dining.Food is good,especially non veg.It is adjoining onJ.P. road.Car parking is available.

featured_reviews.review_text: Very good place for marriage and celebrating any occasion like birthday, parties, munji, naming ceremonies, etc...very vast and comfortable place for the guest to sit in...

featured_reviews.name: Asjad
featured_reviews.review_text:
We recently held our wedding reception at [vishnu Prasad hotel ], and it was moderate experience!

Ambiance: The hall was beautifully decorated and set the perfect.
Space: It comfortably accommodated , with room and dining but the area is small.
Service: The staff was attentive, professional, and ensured everything went smoothly
Limited parking space caused some inconvenience for our guests.
Overall:
We lightly recommend this hall  for anyone looking for a stunning and well-organized banquet hall for their wedding. It made our day  special.

featured_reviews.name: Vali C
featured_reviews.review_text:
Good for a small party (100 or 150 people), if you are on a budget.

There's no lift though, so even the elderly and tge disabled have to climb the stairs to the first floor.

They provide a separate private room with a toilet as a part of the booking, so that's nice.

featured_reviews.name: Aadil Khan
featured_reviews.review_text: ya good place for small function

featured_reviews.name: Nick Dsouza
featured_reviews.review_text:
Nice & Decent Hall for  middle class people
Typically u need around 25k to 30k for a day
Ample Space for around 200 people... Usually good for Engagements... Just one drawback is that there is very less space for lunch... Overall u will b satisfied...

featured_reviews.name: Jay Soni
featured_reviews.review_text: Washrooms are not clean, otherwise hall is good for 100 people

featured_reviews.name: Daniel Dsilva
featured_reviews.review_text: This place is visible from linking road and is walkable from Khar Station. If you'd like to come by bus, then the nearest 220 bus stop is not far away. The hall is considerably small sized and caterers have to go through the hall premise to the food counter which can be a disturbance during the event. Washroom and greenroom are good with ample amount of privacy.

featured_reviews.name: Sailesh Kalra
featured_reviews.review_text: Good decent hall with ac for functions etc. Located in a quiet lane and easily accessible from linking road. Some parking is also possible in the same lane. Washrooms are not so clean though.

name: Jainam Banquet Hall
description:
Jainam Banquet Hall is the perfect choice for hosting special events in Bhandup, Mumbai. Our luxurious and spacious banquet halls, Jainam Classic Hall and Jainam Status Hall, can accommodate up to 500 and 1000 guests respectively, while our newly renovated Party Hall can host up to 200 guests for small gatherings.
Our banquet halls feature high ceilings, separate areas for each important part of your event, and a separate area for wedding ceremonies. The interiors are exquisitely decorated, giving each space a comfortable and airy atmosphere.

featured_reviews.name: Manish Panchal
featured_reviews.review_text: Nice banquet Hall. Space is sufficient for function. Neat and clean toilets it’s LBS road touch. Nearest Railway station is Bhandup. Nearest bus stop is Bhandup Police Station and Shangrila. Visit this hall and get great experience…

featured_reviews.name: Bhushan Kudav
featured_reviews.review_text:
Very decent Banquet Hall. Plenty of parking space for upto 25 cars. Nice air conditioned hall. Clean washrooms. Extra spacious changing rooms which are separate than hall. Support staff is well mannered and helpful.
Catering service is quick. All food items served are tasty.

featured_reviews.name: Adesh Patil
featured_reviews.review_text: Hall is good with nice cooling system. Food was also good. Only to add AC or sufficient cooling system in food area so each one can enjoy them food.

featured_reviews.name: Yash Dharme
featured_reviews.review_text:
An excellent choice for entertaining your selected guests for all your special events. We specialize in wedding receptions, business functions, conventions, reunions, celebrations, fine dining, bridal showers, company luncheons & more!
The Jainam banquet is located on LBS Marg in Bhandup west which is convenient from Bhandup Railway station which is just 10 min away. As it is located on the main road, it is easy to spot the venue saving a lot of time.
The Jainam banquet is surrounded by industrial galas. There is two wheeler and four wheeler  parking available in the premises.

featured_reviews.name: Nilangi Shah
featured_reviews.review_text: AC hall for functions like Marriages party, get together, pedi engagement birthday parties etc and interior is good. Changing rooms with AC is cool. Changing rooms are in good condition. Food is tasty. All well here.

featured_reviews.name: Sagar Markal
featured_reviews.review_text: Nice party Hall. Perfect location for guest to travell. Various options are available as per your requirements. Food quality is good. Veg lovers will be more happy as this place doesn't allow non veg. Full support for event planning vendors from Jainam management for arrangement. Staff is very supportive

featured_reviews.name: siddharth dey
featured_reviews.review_text: It has a good parking area and bangon lbs marg which is easily accessible if you travel by car or train. The hall get over crowded if you have guest kore than 150 people. The have seperat section for food stalls. It's on 1st floor.

featured_reviews.name: Yashwant Jagdhane
featured_reviews.review_text: A small medium hall. It is a 2 floor building. Every floor has a sufficient hall.

featured_reviews.review_text: We had visited the hall for a small get together.  Though the hall ambiance is okay... entrance to the hall from the main road is very narrow and parking issues are there.

featured_reviews.name: Suresh Nair
featured_reviews.review_text: Decent, clean and well managed hall for small gatherings. As the hall is inside a small lane, you could miss the lane. It is advisable to park your four wheelers on the main road and not try your luck inside the lane.

featured_reviews.review_text:
A simple Society Hall .. ideal for upto 100 people.
Limited parking.

Food, provided by Hamant Randive was extremely delicious

featured_reviews.name: Shashikant Mahimkar
featured_reviews.review_text: Very good Hall for all ceremonies in Suyog residential complex. Small in size but well equipped. Near to Bhandup Railway Station.

featured_reviews.name: Shirish Shenolikar
featured_reviews.review_text: This is small size multipurpose hall suitable for birthday parties, Anniversary celebration, thread ceremony or any other religious function. It is comfortably air-conditioned and doesn't seem to have monopoly for catering. Located in Mulund East , it's easily accessible by road and train. The only drawback is lack of parking near the hall.

featured_reviews.name: Sudhir Kulkarni
featured_reviews.review_text: Good , small hall for various functions.

featured_reviews.name: Narendra Gonbare
featured_reviews.review_text:
Compact AC hall near Mulund Railway station on the east side.
It's walking distance from Mulund Railway station. Parking needs to be done on roads across the Suyog Society and it is limited.
